name: Glendale Heights FMC Winter 2023

venue.name: Glenside Public Library
venue.address: 25 E Fullerton Ave, Glendale Heights, IL 60139

information:
This competition only holds the Fewest Moves event. As such, it is not recommended for first time competitors to attend. If you are looking for a more traditional competition that holds events like 3x3, 2x2, or Pyraminx, please check out other competitions in Illinois. 

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcll0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c5462feacf32808de5791361d7ec2621bbee11e5/image.png)
